purpose: Describe doing something without another action.
keywords: I went out without eating breakfast.
I read without looking at a dictionary.
I came without bringing an umbrella.
restrictions: For cause-related adjective negatives, なくて may be needed instead.
mistake: Use a negative verb here; ないで is not a general replacement for every negative connector.

segments.role: Describe doing something without another action. ない-form + で + main action.

examples.translation: I went out without eating breakfast.
